name: Headsman Rano
bio: Rano’s story, and his old identity, are mysteries. All that is known is that he turned against the Emperor and was offered a choice: the executioner’s block, or the executioner’s armor. He chose the armor, and gave up everything else. Only the hand of the Emperor remains.
